environment.description: Terraform provider running on an EC2 instance (Amazon Linux 2) with IAM role granting full S3 and local filesystem access. The provider binary runs as root via a systemd service for Terraform Cloud agent. The working directory /opt/terraform/workspaces/ is writable by the terraform user. No filesystem integrity monitoring. No mandatory access control (SELinux in permissive mode). The instance is in a private subnet with no inbound internet access but the symlink attack is local privilege escalation.
